unavailable.title: Mailbox status is unavailable
unavailable.description: We could not check your mailbox right now. Try again when you are ready.

notConfigured.title: Mailbox is not configured
notConfigured.description: Ask your administrator to set up mailbox access for your account.

provisioning.title: Mailbox setup is in progress
provisioning.description: Your mailbox is being prepared. Refresh this status to check again.

suspended.title: Mailbox is suspended
suspended.description: Mailbox access is temporarily unavailable. Contact your administrator if this continues.

error.title: Mailbox needs attention
error.description: Mailbox access is unavailable right now. Refresh the status or contact your administrator.

deleting.title: Mailbox is being removed
deleting.description: Mailbox access is unavailable while this account is being removed.

active.title: Mailbox is ready
active.workspace: Select a mailbox folder to view its conversations.

errors.toRequired: Add at least one recipient in To.
errors.duplicateRecipient: Each email address can appear only once.
errors.tooManyRecipients: A recipient field can contain up to 100 addresses.
errors.attachmentCount: You can attach up to 50 files.
errors.attachmentLimit: Each file must be 25 MB or smaller and have a valid name.
errors.identityUnavailable: A sending address is unavailable right now.
errors.saveFailed: This draft is not saved. Retry before closing or sending.
errors.uploadFailed: The attachment was not uploaded. Retry or remove it.
errors.removeFailed: The attachment could not be removed.
errors.discardFailed: The draft could not be discarded.
errors.attachmentNotReady: An attachment has not passed its security check yet.
errors.conflict: This draft changed elsewhere or needs recovery. Retry safely.
errors.busy: Mail is temporarily busy. Try again shortly.
errors.rejected: The message does not meet the current sending limits.
errors.sendFailed: The message was not accepted for sending. The draft remains open.

sidebar.title: Folders
sidebar.emptyDescription: Mailbox folders will appear here after synchronization finishes.
sidebar.rebuilding: Refreshing folders. Current folders may be out of date.
sidebar.degraded: Folder data may be out of date.

threadList.title: All Mail
threadList.partialUnavailable: Some conversations may not be current. Your loaded conversations are still shown.
threadList.partialEmpty: The previously loaded empty result may be out of date.
threadList.emptyDescription: New mail will appear here after it has been synchronized.
threadList.filteredEmptyDescription: Try changing or clearing your filters.
threadList.end: You have reached the end of this mailbox.
threadList.rebuilding: Refreshing conversations. Current rows may be out of date.
threadList.degraded: Conversation data may be out of date.

bulk.label: Bulk actions for selected conversations
bulk.limitReached: A maximum of 200 conversations can be selected.
bulk.partial: Updated {{succeeded}} of {{affected}} messages; {{failed}} failed. Review the selection before trying again.
bulk.failed: No messages were updated. Review the selection before trying again.
bulk.unknown: The result is unknown. No automatic retry was made.
bulk.busyExhausted: Mail is still busy. No further retry was made.
bulk.conflict: The selected conversations changed. Review the selection before trying again.
bulk.requestFailed: The bulk action could not be completed.
bulk.confirmDescription: Messages in the selected conversations will move to Trash.

folder.invalidDescription: The folder address is invalid or no longer available.

reader.title: Conversation
reader.emptyDescription: Choose a conversation to read it here.
reader.unavailable: This conversation is unavailable right now.
reader.partialUnavailable: Some conversation metadata may be out of date. Loaded messages remain visible.
reader.partialEmpty: The previously loaded empty conversation may be out of date.
reader.noMessagesDescription: Messages will appear here after mailbox synchronization finishes.
reader.end: You have reached the latest message in this conversation.
reader.invalidDescription: The conversation address is invalid or no longer available.
reader.metadataOnly: Message preview only; full content is not loaded in this view.

body.unavailable: This message is unavailable right now.
body.partialUnavailable: This loaded message may be out of date.
body.remoteImagesBlocked: Remote images are blocked and were not loaded.
body.plainUnavailable: No plain-text message body is available.
body.richUnavailable: A rich-text version exists but is not displayed in this view.
body.downloadFailed: This attachment could not be downloaded. Try again.

reply.label: Reply to message
reply.busy: Mail is temporarily busy. Retry in {{seconds}} s.
reply.conflict: This reply cannot be repeated safely. Start a new reply.
reply.unknown: The reply result is unknown. Do not retry automatically.

draftActions.label: Reply, reply all, or forward
draftActions.busy: Mail is temporarily busy. Retry {{action}} in {{seconds}} s.
draftActions.conflict: {{action}} cannot be repeated safely. Start it again.
draftActions.unknown: The {{action}} result is unknown. Do not retry automatically.

actions.label: Message actions
actions.moveUnavailable: Folders are unavailable. The message was not moved.
actions.trashDescription: This message will be moved to Trash.
actions.unknown: The action may have been applied. Its final state is unknown; do not repeat it automatically.
actions.busy: Mail is temporarily busy. Retry this exact action in {{seconds}} s.
actions.conflict: This action cannot be repeated safely. Start a new action if needed.
actions.partial: Some changes could not be applied
actions.failed: The action was not applied. Local data was not changed.
